text:
ana (AE): Hey team — FinReg Co wants our vendor risk pack for the PoC. Main asks: a clear data flow diagram showing EU-only residency, a full subprocessor list, and confirmation of encryption/KMS. They want this in 48h for their security review.

sam (Security): Thanks Ana. Quick Qs: 1) Is the PoC on Hosted API or Dedicated? 2) Any customer-supplied keys/HSM? 3) Expected data types (PII, financial identifiers)?

mike (Solutions): They're starting on Hosted API but want the option to switch to Dedicated if required. PoC payloads include customer identifiers and transaction metadata (no raw bank files).

ilana (Product): For EU residency requirement we can promise region-limited routing to eu-west endpoints and an option for Dedicated in a eu-only VPC. Need to call out logs/metrics residency separately.

sam (Security): Good. Key items to show in the diagram: ingress path, transient KV cache, model inference layer (with quantized weights), and any third-party subprocessors (storage, monitoring, telemetry). Also show where we apply encryption at-rest and in-transit.

mike (Solutions): I'll draft an architecture diagram. Thinking of a 2-layer diagram: (1) Data ingress -> request router (region policy) -> model serving pool -> response; (2) Sidecar services: metrics -> Datadog (subprocessor), object store -> S3-compatible (subprocessor), secrets -> KMS (customer or our KMS).

ana (typo) (ops-bot): deploy-bot: attachment uploaded: DF_finreg_v1.png

ana (ops-bot) is a mistake — ignore deploy-bot noise.

ana (AE): @sam @mike please include explicit notes about: tokenization (no raw storage beyond ephemeral), KV cache eviction policy, data retention window for logs, and how we redact identifiers in traces. The buyer will nitpick retention timers.

sam (Security): Will do. For the subprocessor list we should include: Cloud provider compute (region-specific), S3-compatible object store (backups), Datadog (monitoring), Sentry (error telemetry), Segment? (if used), and our 3rd-party model quantization provider (if applicable). We should confirm exact vendors and org-level contracts.

mike (Solutions): I have a living subprocessor CSV in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/subprocessors — I'll export the current vendor list, annotate which ones handle EU data, and mark whether they have SCCs in place.

sam (Security): Great. Also add our SOC2 + ISO statements and the list of compliance artifacts (SOC2 report, penetration test summary, Data Processing Addendum with SCCs). They asked specifically about key management: we support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) in Dedicated and also KMS integration for Hosted (customer-managed via partner HSM is possible for enterprise). Note this in the doc.

mike (Solutions): Draft plan: 1) Dataflow diagram (PNG + ASCII quick view) 2) Subprocessor CSV (annotated) 3) Short narrative: residency, retention, encryption, key mgmt, logs. I can have the first pass in ~12 hours.

sam (Security): I'll check the wording on retention windows and redact guidance. We should propose default retention: 7 days for request logs, 90 days for aggregated metrics, option to shorten to 0-30 days for enterprise.

ana (AE): Perfect. Can you both confirm you will own the artifacts? I can forward to the buyer once compiled. They also asked for a minimal data flow ascii snippet they can drop into their internal review doc.

mike (Solutions): I'll include this minimal ASCII snippet in the doc:

```
Client (EU) -> HTTPS -> Region Router (eu-only) -> Inference Pool (ephemeral KV cache) -> Response
                         |-> Metrics -> Datadog (EU region)
                         |-> Storage -> S3 (encrypted, EU bucket)
```

sam (Security): Note: replace Datadog with "Monitoring subprocessor (Datadog or EU alternative)" for buyers who require EU-only telemetry. Also add note about IP geofencing and VPC peering for Dedicated.

mike (Solutions): Uploading draft bundle to Confluence under FinReg PoC page and pinging here when ready.

ops-bot: confluence-bot: page created: /security/finreg-poc (link)

ana (AE): Thanks — once you both post, I'll schedule a 30-min call with their InfoSec to walk through.

sam (Security): One last ask — they requested explicit confirmation that no model weights or training data will be shared back to vendor systems. I'll add a short statement.

mike (Solutions): Added. Will also include a signed statement template for their vendor risk intake.

ana (AE): Awesome. Deadline: 48h from now — I'll follow up if they push earlier. :thumbsup:

mike (Solutions): Noted, target delivery in 12 hours for draft.

sam (Security): Will review by EOD.

ana (AE): thanks team!
